name: WC Account HorizonNav
author: Guru Plugins

sections.description:
WC Account HorizonNav transforms the default WooCommerce “My Account” menu into a sleek, fully customizable horizontal navigation menu. Say goodbye to the standard vertical layout and take full control of your menu design, styling, and responsiveness—all without modifying WooCommerce core files.

Features:
– Converts the WooCommerce “My Account” menu into a clean, modern horizontal menu.
– Customize colors, margins, padding, font sizes, and weights directly from the settings panel.
– Responsive design with a mobile-friendly hamburger menu.
– Modify text colors, hover effects, menu background, and more.
– No coding required—configure everything from the WordPress admin panel.

Customization Options Include:
– Desktop Menu: Adjust margins, text colors, hover effects, font sizes, and font weights.
– Mobile Menu: Control the hamburger icon styling, background color, menu text colors, font styles, and spacing.
– Full Control Over Spacing: Customize menu item margins and menu link spacing for both desktop and mobile.
– Dark Mode Support: (Coming soon to the Pro version.)

How It Works:
– Install & activate the plugin.
– Navigate to WooCommerce ? HorizonNav Settings in the WordPress admin panel.
– Customize your menu with colors, fonts, and layout adjustments.
– Save your settings, and your WooCommerce account menu updates instantly.

This plugin is lightweight, performance-optimized, and does not modify WooCommerce core files, ensuring compatibility with updates and themes.

Upgrade your WooCommerce account page today with WC Account HorizonNav!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wc-account-horizonnav/ directory or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the settings page under the ‘HorizonNav Settings’ under the WooCommerce menu in the WP dashboard to customize the WC account menu.
sections.faq:
1. Does this plugin modify WooCommerce core files?
    No, WC Account HorizonNav does not modify any WooCommerce core files. It uses hooks and CSS to customize the “My Account” menu layout.

  2. Can I revert back to the default vertical menu if needed?
    Yes, you can disable the horizontal menu at any time by going to WooCommerce ? HorizonNav Settings and turning off the customization options.

  3. Is this plugin mobile-friendly?
    Yes! The plugin includes a responsive hamburger menu for mobile users, ensuring a seamless experience on all devices.

  4. Can I change the colors and fonts of the menu?
    Absolutely! You can customize menu colors, hover effects, font sizes, font weights, and more directly from the settings panel.

  5. Will this plugin work with my theme?
    Yes, WC Account HorizonNav is designed to work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes. If you encounter styling issues, minor CSS adjustments may be required.

  6. Can I add custom links to the My Account menu?
    The free version does not support adding custom links. However, this feature may be available in a Pro version with enhanced customization options.

  7. Does this plugin support RTL (Right-to-Left) languages?
    Yes, WC Account HorizonNav supports RTL languages, and the menu will automatically adjust for right-to-left layouts.

  8. Will this plugin slow down my website?
    No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. It only loads necessary styles and scripts when needed, ensuring fast page speeds.
